review.draftParagraph: We cannot determine whether storm conditions occurred because no weather station covers your postcode and the date is not yet past. The adjuster treated the ridge-tile damage as maintenance-related, but provided no dated photographs or reasoned explanation to prove that exclusion applies. Under Ombudsman guidance (DRN-4193511, DRN-4626921), the insurer must prove an exclusion it relies on. On the current file, the decline recommendation does not meet that standard.
